author: XBOX
description:
XBOX is back at the world's biggest video game show in Cologne Germany. We're bringing you all the best moments from day two of our live broadcast from the heart of the XBOX booth. 

Catch up on some of the biggest news, developer demos and interviews, fresh trailers, and updates from our first-party studios and partners around the world. From deeper dives into the newly announced PUBG DED.NET, the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 beta, and the ROG XBOX Ally X20, to fresh gameplay of Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen, STRANGER THAN HEAVEN, Turok: Origins, and multiple updates to Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, our XBOX gamescom 2026 day two show was packed full of announcements, new trailers, and gameplay reveals.

Whether you're catching up here, or checking out the Day 2 Broadcast, we’re thrilled to share what’s next for XBOX: https://youtu.be/98FohkDoNaU?list=PLalmHZuO9Neg

description:
In Fable, you’ll flow seamlessly between melee, ranged, and magical abilities as you come face-to-face with classic creatures and new threats lurking across Albion.

Experiment with different loadouts, discover powerful spell combinations, and choose the combat style that feels right for you as you carve your own path through Albion.

Fable launches February 23, 2027. Pre-Order to receive the Pre-Order Content Pack, featuring the questionably heroic Chicken Suit and a collection of charming in-game gifts. You'll get up to 5 days Early Access with the Premium Edition: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/fable-premium-edition/9NB0ZZ452WF1/0017/9MVMDP11N6SD?wfExp=382CT
